pairs: Erat autem quidam languens Lazarus a Bethania,
Now there was a certain sick man,
from the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
(Maria autem erat quæ unxit Dominum unguento,
And Mary was the one who anointed the Lord with ointment
et extersit pedes ejus capillis suis:
and wiped his feet with her hair;
Miserunt ergo sorores ejus ad eum dicentes:
Therefore, his sisters sent to him, saying:
behold, he whom you love is sick.”
Then, upon hearing this, Jesus said to them:
Infirmitas hæc non est ad mortem,
but for the glory of God,
ut glorificetur Filius Dei per eam.
so that the Son of God may be glorified by it.”
Even so, after he heard that he was sick,
tunc quidem mansit in eodem loco duobus diebus;
he then still remained in the same place for two days.
deinde post hæc dixit discipulis suis:
Then, after these things, he said to his disciples,
the Jews are even now seeking to stone you.
And would you go there again?”
“Are there not twelve hours in the day?
If anyone walks in the daylight,
because he sees the light of this world.
But if he walks in the nighttime,
quia lux non est in eo.
because the light is not in him.”
Hæc ait, et post hæc dixit eis:
He said these things, and after this,
he said to them: “Lazarus our friend is sleeping.
sed vado ut a somno excitem eum.
But I am going, so that I may awaken him from sleep.”
Dixerat autem Jesus de morte ejus:
But Jesus had spoken about his death.
illi autem putaverunt quia de dormitione somni diceret.
Yet they thought that he spoke about the repose of sleep.
Tunc ergo Jesus dixit eis manifeste:
Therefore, Jesus then said to them plainly,
et gaudeo propter vos, ut credatis,
And I am glad for your sake that I was not there,
But let us go to him.”
so that we may die with him.”
et invenit eum quatuor dies jam in monumento habentem.
And he found that he had already been in the tomb for four days.
(Erat autem Bethania juxta Jerosolymam quasi stadiis quindecim.)
(Now Bethania was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia.)
Multi autem ex Judæis venerant ad Martham et Mariam,
And many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary,
ut consolarentur eas de fratre suo.
so as to console them over their brother.
Martha ergo ut audivit quia Jesus venit,
Therefore, Martha, when she heard that Jesus was arriving,
But Mary was sitting at home.
And then Martha said to Jesus:
my brother would not have died.
et nunc scio quia quæcumque poposceris a Deo,
I know that whatever you will request from God,
Scio quia resurget in resurrectione in novissimo die.
“I know that he shall rise again, at the resurrection on the last day.”
“I am the Resurrection and the Life.
et omnis qui vivit et credit in me,
and believes in me shall not die for eternity.
ego credidi quia tu es Christus,
I have believed that you are the Christ,
Filius Dei vivi, qui in hunc mundum venisti.
the Son of the living God, who has come into this world.”
And when she had said these things,
et vocavit Mariam sororem suam silentio,
and called her sister Mary quietly,
nondum enim venerat Jesus in castellum:
For Jesus had not yet arrived in the town.
sed erat adhuc in illo loco, ubi occurrerat ei Martha.
But he was still at that place where Martha had met him.
qui erant cum ea in domo, et consolabantur eam,
the Jews who were with her in the house and who were consoling her,
cum vidissent Mariam quia cito surrexit, et exiit,
when they had seen that Mary rose up quickly and went out,
Quia vadit ad monumentum, ut ploret ibi.
“She is going to the tomb, so that she may weep there.”
when Mary had arrived to where Jesus was,
she fell down at his feet,
my brother would not have died.”
et Judæos, qui venerant cum ea, plorantes,
and the Jews who had arrived with her weeping,
he groaned in spirit and became troubled.
Non poterat hic, qui aperuit oculos cæci nati, facere ut hic non moreretur?
“Would not he who opened the eyes of one born blind have been able to cause this man not to die?”
Jesus ergo rursum fremens in semetipso,
Therefore, Jesus, again groaning from within himself,
and a stone had been placed over it.
the sister of him who had died, said to him, “Lord,
for this is the fourth day.”
Nonne dixi tibi quoniam si credideris,
“Did I not say to you that if you believe,
you shall see the glory of God?”
Therefore, they took away the stone.
gratias ago tibi quoniam audisti me.
I give thanks to you because you have heard me.
Ego autem sciebam quia semper me audis, sed propter populum qui circumstat,
And I know that you always hear me, but I have said this for the sake of the people who are standing nearby,
dixi: ut credant quia tu me misisti.
so that they may believe that you have sent me.”
When he had said these things,
he cried in a loud voice,
Et statim prodiit qui fuerat mortuus,
he who had been dead went forth,
bound at the feet and hands with winding bands.
et facies illius sudario erat ligata.
And his face was bound with a separate cloth.
who had come to Mary and Martha,
and who had seen the things that Jesus did,
Quidam autem ex ipsis abierunt ad pharisæos,
But certain ones among them went to the Pharisees
et dixerunt eis quæ fecit Jesus.
and told them the things that Jesus had done.
the high priests and the Pharisees gathered a council,
quia hic homo multa signa facit?
For this man accomplishes many signs.
in this way all will believe in him.
And then the Romans will come
since he was the high priest that year,
nec cogitatis quia expedit vobis ut unus moriatur homo pro populo,
Nor do you realize that it is expedient for you that one man should die for the people,
and that the entire nation should not perish.”
Hoc autem a semetipso non dixit:
Yet he did not say this from himself,
sed cum esset pontifex anni illius,
but since he was the high priest that year,
prophetavit, quod Jesus moriturus erat pro gente,
he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation.
And not only for the nation,
sed ut filios Dei, qui erant dispersi, congregaret in unum.
but in order to gather together as one the children of God who have been dispersed.
Ab illo ergo die cogitaverunt ut interficerent eum.
Therefore, from that day, they planned to put him to death.
Jesus ergo jam non in palam ambulabat apud Judæos,
And so, Jesus no longer walked in public with the Jews.
sed abiit in regionem juxta desertum,
But he went into a region near the desert,
to a city which is called Ephraim.
et ibi morabatur cum discipulis suis.
And he lodged there with his disciples.
Now the Passover of the Jews was near.
et ascenderunt multi Jerosolymam de regione ante Pascha,
And many from the countryside ascended to Jerusalem before the Passover,
so that they might sanctify themselves.
Quærebant ergo Jesum, et colloquebantur ad invicem,
in templo stantes: Quid putatis, quia non venit ad diem festum?
And they conferred with one another,
Dederant autem pontifices et pharisæi mandatum ut si quis cognoverit ubi sit,
while standing in the temple: “What do you think?
Will he come to the feast day?”
And the high priests and Pharisees had given an order, so that if anyone would know where he may be, he should reveal it, so that they might apprehend him.
